description:
Cast Sprouting Phytohydra by paying {4}{G}.
When Sprouting Phytohydra enters the battlefield, Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to Sprouting Phytohydra.
Sprouting Phytohydra dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2.
